title: Episode 4: The Surgeon's Apprentice
storySoFar: The Warehouse Wars heat up in the bingo hall. Boss Chain and his Warehouse Faction (Cargo Crusher, Ragged Ray, Tiny Terrorizer) battle The Clinic's methodical assault: Spike Surgeon has targeted Chain's arm, while Doc Carnage continues softening up Crusher. Cargo Crusher fights Trash King in an escalating garbage war. Lady Mayhem holds the Scarlet Throne against Scarlet Skull's theatrical brutality. Chrome Viper hunts unpredictable champion Neon Nightmare, who holds the Warehouse Championship under Velvet Rope's management. A mysterious newcomer arrives, aligned with Spike—the Surgeon gains an apprentice.

debuts.name: Scalpel Kid
debuts.gimmick: A lanky, eager surgical prodigy in a white coat and mask. Moves with clinical precision, obsesses over 'perfect form,' and worships Spike Surgeon as his mentor. Treats every match like an anatomy lesson.
debuts.entrance: to the sharp hiss of a surgical drill

beats.title: Opening: The Clinic Expands
beats.recap: Spike Surgeon arrives with a mysterious apprentice—Scalpel Kid—and declares war on the Warehouse Faction.

lines: The arm is just the beginning.
Boss Chain, your body is my operating table.
Chain's arm? Just my first patient.

beats.title: Interview: Cargo Crusher Fires Back
beats.recap: Cargo Crusher interrupts the interview segment to challenge Spike and his new apprentice.

lines: You want pain, kid? I'll show you the weight of a real man!
The Clinic's done operating. Time to shut down.

beats.title: Women's Division: The Phantom Rises
beats.recap: Phantom Jenny faces Chrome Viper in a technical showcase that ends in controversy.

beats.title: Velvet Rope's Power Play
beats.recap: Velvet Rope corners Phantom Jenny and makes a shocking demand about her allegiance.

exchange.speaker: frankie_chrome
exchange.text: Velvet, you just cost Phantom Jenny the match. Why?

exchange.speaker: velvet_rope
exchange.text: Because I own this company. And Jenny needs to understand who's in charge.

exchange.speaker: frankie_chrome
exchange.text: Are you offering her an opportunity?

exchange.speaker: velvet_rope
exchange.text: I'm offering her a choice: join me, or stay irrelevant. Neon Nightmare didn't waste time picking sides.

beats.title: The Hardcore Crown Match
beats.recap: Cargo Crusher McGraw defends the Hardcore Crown against Trash King Donny in a brutal garbage-filled brawl.

lines: You want trash? Here it is!

beats.text: Darkness attacks after the bell! Where's the Warehouse Faction?!

beats.title: Main Event: The Surgeon's Test
beats.recap: Boss Chain faces Scalpel Kid in a shocking debut match, with Spike Surgeon orchestrating every brutal move from ringside.

lines: That's it, apprentice! The lesson is complete!

beats.text: Scalpel Kid has the Phantom Lock locked in! Boss Chain won't tap—he can't!

lines: Boss Chain, your reign ends when the Clinic decides.
The Surgeon and his apprentice just proved it.

beats.text: The Clinic leaves the bingo hall in control. The Warehouse Faction's grip is slipping!

stateChanges.reason: Scalpel Kid humiliated Boss Chain in his debut match, submitting the faction leader with the Phantom Lock.

stateChanges.text: Velvet Rope openly recruiting talent away from the Warehouse Faction, using her ownership stake to sway wrestlers to her side.
The Clinic now has two surgeons: Spike Surgeon and his new apprentice Scalpel Kid. They're systematically dismantling the Warehouse Faction's credibility.
Phantom Jenny angered by Velvet Rope's power play and mysterious recruitment pitch. Her allegiance is now uncertain.
